title: Battle of Valkininkai (1700)
text: The Battle of Valkininkai took place on November 18, 1700, during the Lithuanian Civil War, between forces of the Sapieha family, led by Michał Franciszek Sapieha, and an anti-Sapieha coalition of Wiśniowiecki, Ogiński, Radziwiłł and Pac families and their supporters, led by Michał Serwacy Wiśniowiecki.
